note: Compact Date Range Formatter adds a 'Compact' field formatter (id daterange_compact) for daterange/datetime/timestamp fields that omits duplicated month/year (e.g. 24-25 January 2017). Compact rules live in the daterange_compact_format config entity type (config prefix daterange_compact.format.<id>; managed at Regional and language settings, route entity.daterange_compact_format.collection). Each format has a required default_pattern plus optional same-day/same-month/same-year start/end patterns and separators (PHP date tokens), and flags zero_minutes_omit / same_day_omit_duplicate_ampm. Two formats ship: medium_date, medium_datetime. The same logic is exposed via the daterange_compact.formatter service. Requires core datetime_range. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config: introspection reads a seeded format's default_pattern/separator; execution creates a new format config entity, or switches a daterange field's display to the daterange_compact formatter, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: I have a core date range (daterange) field showing '24 January 2017 – 25 January 2017'. Using the daterange_compact module, how do I display it compactly as '24–25 January 2017'?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage display, set its format to 'Compact' (the daterange_compact formatter) and choose one of the compact date range formats. It omits the duplicated month/year.

evals.prompt: Where are the compact date range formats managed in the daterange_compact module, and which formats come preinstalled?
evals.expected_output: They are daterange_compact_format config entities managed at Configuration → Regional and language → Compact date and time range formats (route entity.daterange_compact_format.collection). Two ship preinstalled: medium_date and medium_datetime.

evals.prompt: How can I format a compact date range from custom code (not via a field) with the daterange_compact module?
evals.expected_output: Use the daterange_compact.formatter service: formatDateRange(startIso, endIso, $type) for ISO-8601 dates or formatTimestampRange(start, end, $type) for UNIX timestamps; both return a FormattedDateTimeRange you cast to string. $type is a format machine id (defaults medium_date / medium_datetime).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a compact date range format with machine id 'dc_known'. Inspect the live configuration and give its default pattern (default_pattern).
The compact date range format 'dc_known' on this site defines a separator placed between the start and end of a range. Inspect the live configuration and give its default separator string.

On this Drupal site, using the daterange_compact module, create a new compact date range format with machine id 'dc_task', label 'DC Task', and a default pattern of 'Y-m-d'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A daterange_compact_format config entity dc_task exists with default_pattern 'Y-m-d' (config daterange_compact.format.dc_task), e.g. created via the daterange_compact_format storage or the admin form at /admin/config/regional/daterange-compact-format/add.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a date range field field_dc_range currently shown with the default date range formatter. Using the daterange_compact module, change its display on the default view display to the 'Compact' formatter (daterange_compact). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_dc_range component has type: daterange_compact (e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_dc_range', ['type'=>'daterange_compact', 'settings'=>['daterange_compact_format'=>'medium_date']])->save()).
